evals.name: add-authored-component
evals.prompt: In ShiningPie I want a patrol route concept: an entity that marks a path enemies walk, carrying a speed multiplier and a mode that's either Loop or PingPong. Write the component declaration and show me how SceneBinding would read it back into gameplay.
evals.expected_output: A record with a generated [Guid] and [Authored(DisplayName=...)], an enum for the mode, plain setters, no constants class; read back via Materialize + pattern match.

evals.name: green-locally-red-in-ci
evals.prompt: ShiningPie builds fine on my machine and all 204 tests pass, but CI can't even restore. What's going on, and how do I check before I push next time?
evals.expected_output: Explains local builds use the workspace source override while CI restores from NuGet, so an engine change must ship as a package first; recommends verifying with -p:ParadiseUseEngineSource=false.

evals.name: unknown-tuning-component
evals.prompt: I added a camera tuning group to Pingu's config.json but loading it fails saying it's not a component this build knows. Help me debug it.
evals.expected_output: Checks the [Guid] on the record matches the Id in config.json, that the assembly opts into AuthoredRegistry, and that ids are GUIDs parsed rather than name strings.
